setup_filter_2d_fir: setup a 2D FIR filter tensor with normalization, flipping, and gain scaling for upfirdn2d
upfirdn2d_pad_upsample_filter_downsample: pad, upsample, filter, and downsample a batch of 2D images using a fused CUDA or reference op
filter2d_convolve_images: filter a batch of 2D images with a 2D FIR filter and automatic padding
upsample2d_increase_resolution: upsample a batch of 2D images by an integer factor using a 2D FIR filter
downsample2d_decrease_resolution: downsample a batch of 2D images by an integer factor using a 2D FIR filter
